requirement: CHAT-01 Prompt Refiner의 새 confirmatory shadow v4를 구현한다. v4는 새 stage/reservation/run authority로 v3의 소진·만료된 권한과 분리하고, provider가 반환한 refined prompt를 runner 메모리에서 동결 evidence spec으로 평가한 뒤 proposal bytes나 per-item content digest 없이 closed case evidence만 terminal receipt와 같은 transaction에 영속화한다. 완주 뒤 DB의 content-free case evidence와 telemetry만으로 aggregate gate bundle을 재구성할 수 있어야 한다. 배포만으로 stage/run/flag/provider 호출은 발생하지 않으며 실제 유료 실행은 별도 exact 승인 전까지 금지한다. author는 Codex, reviewer는 Claude Code Max다.
completionCriteria: stage/reservation/run v4 identity와 digest가 v3 row를 보존하면서 새 권한을 별도 생성하도록 schema, migration, application validation과 audit metadata에 일치한다.
v4 source closure가 evidence core/spec, runner/writer, schema/migration과 모든 runtime dependency의 exact bytes를 결속한다.
runner는 suggested proposal을 메모리에서만 평가하고 failed/unknown을 포함한 content-free case evidence를 terminal writer에 전달한 뒤 proposal을 저장·로그·API 반환하지 않는다.
terminal writer는 case evidence shape/status/spec binding을 strict 검증하고 terminal receipt·audit·attempt evidence를 한 transaction에 기록하며 동일 facts replay만 허용한다.
완료된 v4 run은 저장된 case evidence와 cost/latency telemetry만으로 동결 aggregate bundle을 재구성하고 pass/fail/insufficient를 반환하며 제품·Router·유료 권한은 모두 false다.
v3 기존 row와 terminal receipt는 변경·재해석하지 않고 v4 migration은 seed, backfill, provider call 또는 flag 변경을 수행하지 않는다.
전체 unit, focused Prompt Refiner, DB integration/contract, TypeScript, ESLint, 문서·정책·schema·protected-writer 검사가 통과한다.
Claude verdict는 exact package digest에 결속하고 actionable finding마다 location, severity, evidence와 reproduction을 기록한다.

findings.claim: The terminal writer accepts any non-negative durationMs (the DB CHECK only requires >= 0, prisma/migrations/20260920120000_prompt_refiner_shadow_run_writer/migration.sql:139) but the durable aggregator caps stored durationMs at 60_000, so a single case slower than 60s produces an immutable terminal row from which the completed run's aggregate bundle can never be rebuilt — readPromptRefinerShadowEvidenceBundle then refuses 409 PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE_INVALID forever, defeating completion criterion 5.
findings.reproduction: In tests/integration/prompt-refiner-shadow-run.db.test.ts, take the existing "completed durable evidence rebuilds a content-free aggregate from all 16 cases" test and change `durationMs: 10 + caseIndex` to `durationMs: 60_001`. Expected per the criterion: a bundle with gateOutcome fail/insufficient. Actual: every recordPromptRefinerShadowTerminal succeeds, the run reaches status completed, and readPromptRefinerShadowEvidenceBundle() throws PromptRefinerShadowRunError code PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE_INVALID (from evidence core `stored_duration_ms_invalid_integer`). The 15s adapter bound does not prevent this: lib/promptRefinerShadowLiveAdapter.ts:294 passes a non-standard `timeout` option to generateText, and the route's maxDuration is 300s. Fix by enforcing the same 60_000 upper bound in terminalInputIsValid (and the DB terminal CHECK) so no unreconstructible row can be written.

findings.location: tests/promptRefinerRuntimeSourceClosure.test.mjs:1231-1250 ("operator-facing contracts name the enforced runtime source closure size")
findings.claim: The change deletes the assertions that pinned five operator/policy documents to the enforced runtime closure size instead of updating those documents, so the shipped operator-facing approval contracts now state a file count and stage identity that the code no longer implements, and the guard that would have caught it is gone.
findings.reproduction: After this commit, `PROMPT_REFINER_RUNTIME_SOURCE_FILE_COUNT` is 188 (lib/promptRefinerStageAdmissionCore.ts:41) and the live stage id/confirmation are `prompt-refiner-shadow-v2` / `APPROVE PROMPT REFINER SHADOW STAGE V2 FOR 60 MINUTES`. Open: docs/ops/prompt-refiner-durable-stage-writer-contract.md:20 ("현재 deployment의 187개 고정 source 파일"), :5 (stage: prompt-refiner-shadow-v1), :9/:38 (STAGE V1 confirmation); docs/ops/prompt-refiner-durable-stage-writer-task.md:17 ("187-file/16 MiB"); docs/policy/prompt-refiner-durable-stage-writer-threat-model.md:40 ("187개 고정 path allowlist"); docs/ops/tomverse-chat-progress.md:1182 ("exact 187-file runtime import-closure source manifest"); docs/policy/prompt-refiner-observability.md:309 ("고정 187개 source 파일") and :49 ("stage는 `prompt-refiner-shadow-v1` 한 행으로 제한되며") — the last file is edited by this change (header at :3-5) yet left stale. `git show 8381e98a -- tests/promptRefinerRuntimeSourceClosure.test.mjs` shows the five removed assertions. `npm run test:unit` passes only because those assertions were deleted.

findings.claim: The new `prompt_refiner_runtime_manifest_valid` wrapper short-circuits to the 187-file v2 validator for any row whose manifest declares schemaVersion v2, without binding that branch to `id = 'prompt-refiner-shadow-v1'`, so the database would accept a `prompt-refiner-shadow-v2` stage bound to the superseded 187-file closure even though the same migration's execution-manifest CHECK pins `"runtimeSource":{"fileCount":188}` for v2 — the two CHECKs on the same row disagree about which closure a v4 authority is bound to.
findings.reproduction: Read migration.sql:27-31 together with the `PromptRefinerReservationStage_runtime_identity_check` (migration.sql:133-141) and the v2 execution-manifest literal (migration.sql:~160). The runtime_identity_check passes for `id='prompt-refiner-shadow-v2'` with any structurally valid 187-file v2 manifest; nothing in the schema rejects it. Application reads (promptRefinerStoredStageMatchesRuntime) would reject such a row, so this is defence-in-depth only, but criterion 1 asks schema/migration/application validation to agree. Fix: gate the v2 branch on `id = 'prompt-refiner-shadow-v1'` (or on the manifest version matching the stage's executionManifest fileCount).

findings.claim: The admission proposal that attests the new v2 stage still declares `reservationStage.stageId = "prompt-refiner-shadow-v1"` and the v1 reservation contract digest as frozen literals, so the v2 stage row's `proposalDigest` attests to a proposal describing a different reservation authority, and the previous coupling that made any reservation-contract change break the proposal digest (and thus force review) is replaced by duplicated constants.
findings.reproduction: Run `node --import tsx -e "import('./lib/promptRefinerShadowAdmissionCore.ts').then(m=>console.log(m.proposePromptRefinerShadowStage))"` conceptually, or simply compare: lib/promptRefinerStageAdmission.ts:566-568 creates the stage with id `prompt-refiner-shadow-v2` and contractDigest `sha256:6b60c957…`, while trustedUnsignedProposal() (lib/promptRefinerShadowAdmissionCore.ts:678) emits `stageId: "prompt-refiner-shadow-v1"` / `sha256:c5cc412e…`, and tests/promptRefinerShadowAdmissionCore.test.mjs:129-138 now asserts the proposal against the duplicated literals instead of the reservation module's live constants. If freezing the historical proposal is intended, state that explicitly in docs/ops/prompt-refiner-confirmatory-shadow-v4.md §1 and add an assertion that the v2 stage's executionManifest — not the proposal — is the authority binding.

findings.claim: The panel renders `${execution.evidence.summary.passedCases}/16` with a hardcoded denominator instead of `summary.attemptedCases`, which the operator-core validator already pins to 16.
findings.reproduction: Read the added Field for `m.evidenceCases`; substitute `summary.attemptedCases` so the displayed denominator comes from the validated payload rather than a literal.

findings.reproduction: Raise PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_RUN_UNKNOWN_AFTER_MS in lib/promptRefinerShadowRunContract.ts to 90_000 (and refresh the contract digest literal the module's self-check prints). unknownTelemetry() then emits durationMs 90_000, terminalInputIsValid refuses it, and every unknown sweep returns PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_TERMINAL_INVALID, so stale dispatch intents can never be closed.
